# Jacked. 💪

A lightweight, fast, and privacy-focused workout tracker designed as a single-file Progressive Web App (PWA). Log your sets, track your strength progression, and monitor workout consistency—all offline and with zero account setup.

---

## ✨ Features

* ⚡ **Ultra Lightweight:** Built as a pure, single-file HTML/CSS/JS application with zero framework dependencies.
* 📈 **Dynamic Progress Charts:** Track your strength gains with automatically generated 1-Rep Max ($\text{1RM}$) trend graphs for every exercise you log.
* 📅 **Consistency Calendar:** Visual monthly calendar view that highlights every day you hit the gym.
* 📝 **Flexible Exercise Logging:** Add custom exercises on the fly with support for set counts, decimal weights, and rep tracking.
* 📱 **Mobile & PWA Ready:** Add it to your home screen on iOS or Android for a seamless, native app feel.
* 🔒 **100% Private & Offline:** All workout history and settings are stored locally on your device via `localStorage`.

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

Since **Jacked.** is a single-file application, running it is simple:

1. **GitHub Pages (Recommended):** Host the `index.html` file on GitHub Pages and open the link on your mobile browser.
2. **Add to Home Screen:** 
   * **iOS (Safari):** Tap the **Share** icon $\rightarrow$ select **Add to Home Screen**.
   * **Android (Chrome):** Tap the **Menu (⋮)** $\rightarrow$ select **Add to Home screen**.

---

## 🛠️ Built With

* **HTML5 Canvas** - Pure native 2D chart rendering
* **CSS3** - Custom Dark Theme variables & responsive grid layouts
* **Vanilla JavaScript** - Fast DOM manipulation & local storage management
